system.description:
A powerful Genjutsu, that puts a creature under an illusion only using words and speech. While in the Genjutsu, the target can be easily swayed by their will and self-assurance. Select a target creature you can see within range; the target must make a Charisma saving throw.

Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effects.

Failure: They are also more inclined to believe the worst-case scenario and are more willing to go against their better judgement and their own goals.

Critical Failure: Affected creature suffers the effects of a failure and becomes paranoid of all other creatures excluding the caster for the duration.
